credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: View of O'Keeffe sitting in the roofless room, dressed in a black wrap dress pointing to the shadows on the wall.  She is surrounded by an array of large rocks and stones. Exterior room at the Abiquiu house with latillas (juniper or alder branches) used for the ceiling; graphic shadows of the crisscrossing ceiling branches reflected on the floor and wall.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe in Abiquiu House Roofless Room
